description: Cheapest eFon per-minute price (EUR and USD) for several countries at once, sorted from cheapest to most expensive, each with its country page URL. Use this when the user calls more than one country ("rates to India, Pakistan and Bangladesh", "which is cheaper to call, Mexico or Colombia?").

countries.description: Up to 20 countries, each in any of the formats above.

items.description: Country name in any language, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or dialing code — e.g. 'Eritrea', 'ER', 'Эритрея', '+291'.

language.description: Language for country names and the returned page links.

name: compare_call_rates
title: Compare eFon call rates across countries
